status.evidence: According to Companies House, VANIR FLEET SERVICES LTD (Company number 16192767) is an active company incorporated on 18 January 2025.

claims.claim: The company reports providing routing and dispatching software powered by a partnership with Geotab that factors in traffic, weather, vehicle types, and deadlines to deliver dynamic multi-stop route optimization, according to the Vanir Fleet Services website.

In an optimization case study published in January 2025, Vanir Fleet equipped its transport and haulage client Vanir Logistics (operating 50+ vehicles including light commercial vehicles, heavy goods vehicles, and trailers) with an integrated Geotab platform deployment to enable real-time tracking, fuel monitoring systems, and tachograph compliance tracking, according to the Vanir Logistics Case Study.
The company reports that its operations are registered with the UK Information Commissioner's Office under registration number ZB903098, as stated on the Vanir Fleet Services Homepage.

The company reports a scalable modular architecture powered by its partnership with Geotab, which allows its benchmarking and fuel management platforms to scale seamlessly as a fleet grows by adding new vehicles and data sources, according to the Vanir Fleet Services Website.

The company reports providing flexible and long-term vehicle hire and telematics solutions tailored for business sizes ranging from sole traders and SMEs up to enterprises managing fleets of 1 to 1,000+ vehicles.

An official telematics platform integration partnership with Geotab, allowing Vanir Fleet Services to power its tracking, safety coaching, and fleet optimization solutions using MyGeotab technology, as detailed on the Vanir Fleet Services Website.

Direct manufacturer partnerships with vehicle OEMs to capture telematics data directly, supporting over 300 battery electric vehicle (BEV) and plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) models on its electric vehicle management platform, as reported on the Vanir Fleet Services Electric Vehicles Page.

The company reports its strategic collaboration as a recognized Geotab partner to integrate hardware and software solutions within its tracking systems, as detailed on the Vanir Fleet Services Platform.

The company reports maintaining operational physical offices at Unit 1A Crystal Trading Estate and Unit 9 Kirkdale House in Liverpool, along with a registered office in Bolton, England, and provides a dedicated customer channel at driversupport@vanirfleetservices.co.uk, according to the Vanir Fleet Services Contact Page.

status.evidence: According to Companies House records, ITRACKING LTD (Company number 06542959) was originally registered at Coleford, Gloucestershire, before changing its office to Newton Abbot, and its status remains active as of 2026.

claims.claim: The company serves as an official sales and installation partner for Webfleet (formerly TomTom Telematics), utilizing their core tracking infrastructure to matching fleet requirements as documented in the Webfleet Sales Partner Directory.

ITracking Limited has partnered with MANTIS to deploy their connected camera video telematics systems, ensuring seamless integration with third-party software platforms like Webfleet to provide fleet analytics, as reported on the iTracking MANTIS Partnership Update.
As a premium partner of Webfleet, the company installs and integrates tracking, camera, and sensor equipment into unified systems for fleets across the South West of England and Wales.
A public spending record from Hampshire County Council shows a transaction of £789.95 paid to iTracking Limited on 1 August 2026 for vehicle workshop spares and services.
The company operates as a Webfleet premium partner to supply integrated fleet management systems and commercial tracking solutions, as stated on the official iTracking website.

The company is designated as a Webfleet Premium Sales Partner in the UK, operating primarily as a regional service provider supplying third-party telematics and fleet management solutions to business fleets in Bristol, the West Country, and South Wales, according to the official Webfleet Partner Directory.
